gaps.lead: He enjoys his work despite his low salary.
gaps.explanation: 'though' can close a sentence as a soft 'however'.

gaps.lead: He no longer thinks he can find a job before the end of the year.
gaps.sentence: He has given ___ a job before the end of the year.
gaps.explanation: 'No longer thinks he can find' becomes 'has given up hope of finding'.

gaps.lead: There's a rumour that the factory will close.
Even though she was exhausted after twelve hours on duty, the surgeon completed the operation.
gaps.sentence: ___ exhausted after twelve hours on duty, the surgeon completed the operation.
gaps.explanation: 'Even though she was' becomes 'in spite of being' — concession + gerund.

gaps.lead: I regret not bringing an umbrella.
gaps.explanation: Regret about the past: wish + subject + had + participle.

gaps.lead: If the government had acted sooner, the crisis could have been avoided.
gaps.sentence: ___ acted sooner, the crisis could have been avoided.
gaps.explanation: Dropping 'if' inverts auxiliary and subject: Had the government acted sooner…
